summary: Read a rectangular grid whose cells contain only the letter X or the letter O. When an O is not on any of the four outer edges, and it also cannot reach an O that sits on an edge by moving up, down, left, or right, replace that whole group of O cells with X. O cells on an edge, together with O cells joined to them by those four moves, stay unchanged. Touching at a corner does not count as a join. Write the grid after the replacements.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
